profile.subtitleJa: エルサレム共同体が選んだ七人の一人
profile.summaryJa: エルサレム共同体が食事の配分を担うために選んだ七人の一人です。本文はステパノを信仰と聖霊に満ちた人と紹介します。

facts.textJa: ステパノは恵みと力に満ち、人々の間で大きなしるしと不思議を行います。
ステパノは石打ちにされ、死に際にイエスに自分の霊を受け入れるよう祈ります。
敬虔な人々がステパノを葬り、深く嘆きます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.
They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’
